name: PhoneInput
description: Searchable country selector (flag + dial code) with a national-number field, wired into the form system.

fields.inputPadding: EdgeInsetsGeometry? - number field padding, 12/8 by default
fields.maxWidth: double? - number field width, 200 by default
fields.selectWidth: double? - country selector width (the popup is trigger-wide), 180 by default
fields.popupConstraints: BoxConstraints? - popup max size, 250x300 by default
fields.countryGap: double? - name-to-dial-code gap in popup rows, 16 by default
